multi_hop.description: Enable multi-hop sync (usually in addition to stage 1).

stage_only.description: If 1, sync only in stage 1. If 2, sync only in stage 2. Omit (0) for full sync.

sync_archives.description: List of archive names to sync. Each item corresponds to an archive defined in ftpsync.conf(5). If empty, 'sync:all' is used.

trigger_mode.description: Override auto-detected trigger mode: either 'ssh' or 'cron'. Use only when automatic detection fails.
